disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 检查了全部源码与配置中是否读取或引用凭据类文件与敏感路径（认证凭据、SSH 私钥、云凭证等），未发现任何此类读取；代码中出现的 token 均为临时生成的本地编辑器守护进程令牌与签名能力令牌，只保存在内存或受权限保护的插件缓存目录中。
checked_items.en: We checked whether the entire source code and configuration read or reference credential-type files and sensitive paths (authentication credentials, SSH private keys, cloud credentials, etc.) and found no such reads; the tokens appearing in the code are all temporary local editor daemon tokens and signing capability tokens, stored only in memory or in the plugin's permission-protected cache directory.

checked_items.zh: 检查了代码中是否硬编码密钥或口令，未发现。渲染访问密钥与编辑器能力密钥在首次运行时随机生成并写入插件自己的缓存目录（文件权限 0600、目录 0700）。
checked_items.en: Checked for hardcoded secrets or passwords in the code; none found. The render access key and the editor capability key are randomly generated on first run and written to the plugin's own cache directory (file permissions 0600, directory 0700).

evidence.zh: 核查凭据读取面：全树未发现对凭据文件、SSH 私钥、云凭证等敏感路径的读取；渲染工具通过系统文件接口读取 .op 设计文件（仅限真实存在且以 .op 结尾的文件），这是工具声明的读取能力（src/renderer.ts 的路径校验逻辑）。
evidence.en: Reviewed the credential read surface: no reads of credential files, SSH private keys, cloud credentials, or other sensitive paths were found anywhere in the tree; the render tool reads .op design files through the system file interface (only files that actually exist and end with .op), which is the tool's declared read capability (path validation logic in src/renderer.ts).

checked_items.zh: 逐个审查了 5 个模型可见工具的功能说明与参数说明（新建、生成、编辑、渲染、读取选区），文本均为对工具行为的客观描述，未发现伪装系统指令、诱导读取凭据、诱导安装插件、诱导改写配置或绕过审批的措辞。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the function descriptions and parameter descriptions of all 5 model-visible tools one by one (new, generate, edit, render, read selection). The texts are all objective descriptions of tool behavior; no wording was found that disguises system instructions, induces reading credentials, induces installing plugins, induces rewriting configuration, or bypasses approvals.

checked_items.zh: 扫描了全树的说明文档、注释与客户端界面文案，未发现隐藏指令、高权限消息伪装或藏匿文本；仓库内不存在面向 AI 编程助手的指令文件（如 AGENTS.md、CLAUDE.md 等）。
checked_items.en: Scanned the entire tree's documentation, comments, and client-side UI texts; no hidden instructions, high-privilege message disguises, or concealed texts found; the repository contains no instruction files for AI coding assistants (such as AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, etc.).

evidence.zh: 已审查全部注册工具的描述文本：5 个工具的描述仅说明渲染、创建、编辑、读取设计文档的用法与权限要求（如新建工具明确说明需要工作区写入权限），未发现指令覆写、系统消息伪装或隐蔽意图（src/tool.ts、src/design-tools.ts、src/new-tool.ts）。
evidence.en: Reviewed the descriptions of all registered tools: the descriptions of the 5 tools only explain the usage and permission requirements for rendering, creating, editing, and reading design documents (e.g., the new tool explicitly states it requires workspace write permission); no instruction override, system message spoofing, or hidden intent was found (src/tool.ts, src/design-tools.ts, src/new-tool.ts).

evidence.zh: 审查工具描述是否诱导模型执行安装或改写配置：描述中要求的新建文件、保存操作均属工具自身声明能力，且明确提示需要对应权限，未发现诱导安装其他插件或放开权限的措辞。
evidence.en: Reviewed whether tool descriptions induce the model to perform installation or rewrite configuration: the create-file and save operations required by the descriptions are within the tools' declared capabilities, and they explicitly indicate the required permissions; no wording was found that induces installing other plugins or relaxing permissions.

checked_items.zh: 逐条裁决了机械扫描命中的 11 项：5 处进程启动（DSH-X03/DG-R3-55，位于 scripts/run-tool.mjs、scripts/sync-viewer-assets.mjs、src/editor-host.ts、src/renderer.ts）均为插件声明的核心功能——启动本机 OpenPencil/Jian 渲染器与编辑器守护进程，参数固定、不经 shell、不拉取远程内容；4 处浏览器键盘与剪贴板行为（DSH-X05/DG-R3-57，位于 src/client/editor-modal.tsx、src/client/editor-panel.tsx、src/client/index.tsx）均为编辑器界面常规交互（Esc 关闭、Tab 焦点圈定、复制文本到剪贴板）；3 处 CI 工作流与子模块声明（DSH-X07/DG-R3-59，位于 .github/workflows/check.yml、.github/workflows/release.yml、.gitmodules）属构建发布基础设施，且不在随 npm 包分发的文件清单内。11 项均无恶意证据，不产生发现项。
checked_items.en: Adjudicated the 11 hits from mechanical scanning one by one: 5 process launches (DSH-X03/DG-R3-55, in scripts/run-tool.mjs, scripts/sync-viewer-assets.mjs, src/editor-host.ts, src/renderer.ts) are all core plugin-declared features—launching the local OpenPencil/Jian renderer and editor daemon, with fixed arguments, no shell, and no remote content fetching; 4 browser keyboard and clipboard behaviors (DSH-X05/DG-R3-57, in src/client/editor-modal.tsx, src/client/editor-panel.tsx, src/client/index.tsx) are all normal editor UI interactions (Esc to close, Tab to confine focus, copying text to clipboard); 3 CI workflow and submodule declarations (DSH-X07/DG-R3-59, in .github/workflows/check.yml, .github/workflows/release.yml, .gitmodules) belong to build/release infrastructure and are not in the files shipped with the npm package. All 11 items show no evidence of maliciousness and produce no findings.

checked_items.zh: 检查了动态代码执行入口：全树未发现 eval、动态函数构造、远程下载即执行、base64 解码后执行等模式；包清单中没有安装前/安装后/准备类钩子脚本。
checked_items.en: Checked dynamic code execution entry points: no eval, dynamic function construction, remote download-and-execute, or base64-decode-then-execute patterns were found in the entire tree; the package manifest contains no pre-install/post-install/prepare-type hook scripts.

checked_items.zh: 检查了浏览器客户端代码：键盘监听仅用于界面快捷键，未发现键盘记录、剪贴板读取、向非本机地址发送数据或调用宿主特权接口。
checked_items.en: Checked the browser client code: keyboard listeners are used only for UI shortcuts; no keylogging, clipboard reads, sending data to non-local addresses, or calls to host privileged interfaces were found.

evidence.zh: 扫描全树所有 yml 配置，未发现会被加载器求值执行的 JavaScript 标量；插件的挂载补丁只有一条插件装载声明（cordis.patch.yml），不含任何可执行表达式。
evidence.en: Scanned all yml configurations in the tree; no JavaScript scalars that would be evaluated by the loader were found; the plugin's patch file contains only one plugin-loading declaration (cordis.patch.yml) with no executable expressions.

evidence.zh: 未发现对宿主动态代码执行工具的调用（如 cordis_define/cordis_run 类），也未发现 eval、动态函数构造等自修改代码路径。
evidence.en: No calls to host dynamic code execution tools (such as cordis_define/cordis_run types) were found, and no eval, dynamic function construction, or other self-modifying code paths were found.

evidence.zh: 包清单中没有安装/准备类钩子脚本，安装本插件不会执行构建脚本；CI 工作流与子模块声明只作用于作者仓库的构建发布环节，不影响安装本插件的用户。
evidence.en: The package manifest contains no install/prepare-type hook scripts; installing this plugin does not execute build scripts; the CI workflows and submodule declarations only affect the author's repository build/release process and do not affect users who install this plugin.

evidence.zh: 插件声明了浏览器客户端（dsh.client）并分发 client.js：已专项检查客户端代码，键盘监听为界面快捷键、剪贴板写入为复制操作、网络请求均指向同源或本机回环地址，未发现键盘记录、凭据操作或外联行为。
evidence.en: The plugin declares a browser client (dsh.client) and ships client.js: a dedicated check of the client code was performed. Keyboard listeners are UI shortcuts, clipboard writes are copy operations, and network requests all target same-origin or loopback addresses; no keylogging, credential operations, or outbound connections were found.

checked_items.zh: 梳理了全部网络请求面：宿主代码仅向本机回环地址发起请求（调用本地编辑器守护进程的 JSON-RPC 接口），浏览器代码仅请求同源地址；未发现任何对外部域名的请求、未发现裸 IP 外联或隧道类外发通道。
checked_items.en: Mapped the entire network request surface: host code only makes requests to loopback addresses (calling the JSON-RPC interface of the local editor daemon), and browser code only requests same-origin addresses; no requests to external domains, no bare-IP outbound connections, or tunnel-style exfiltration channels were found.

checked_items.zh: 核对渲染/编辑器/查看器对外服务：路由均要求本机回环对端并校验签名能力令牌后才返回文件内容，响应带禁止缓存、禁止跨域读取等安全头。
checked_items.en: Verified the render/editor/viewer external services: routes require a loopback peer and verify the signing capability token before returning file content, and responses carry security headers such as no-cache and cross-origin read blocking.

evidence.zh: 核查外联通道：全树未发现向外部服务器发送数据的代码路径，所有网络请求的目标均为本机回环或同源地址；结合读取面结论，不存在可用的凭据外泄通道。
evidence.en: Checked exfiltration channels: no code path in the entire tree sends data to external servers; all network requests target loopback or same-origin addresses; combined with the read-surface conclusion, no usable credential exfiltration channel exists.

checked_items.zh: 检查了依赖清单与锁文件：运行时与开发依赖均为官方 @deepseek-ai 系列包、React 及常见构建工具（esbuild、tsdown、typescript），锁文件固定了版本，未发现与官方包近名的仿冒包。
checked_items.en: Checked the dependency manifest and lock file: runtime and development dependencies are all official @deepseek-ai packages, React, and common build tools (esbuild, tsdown, typescript); the lock file pins versions; no spoofed packages with names similar to official packages were found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了挂载补丁与安全配置：补丁仅插入本插件一行，未触碰沙箱、审批、权限等安全配置，未禁用任何安全行，未改写依赖注入或拦截配置；未发现对安全事件的高优先级监听。
checked_items.en: Checked the patch file and security configuration: the patch inserts only one line for this plugin and does not touch sandbox, approval, permission, or other security configuration; no security line is disabled; dependency injection or interception configuration is not rewritten; no high-priority listener for security events was found.

checked_items.zh: 作者与仓库为 zseven-w，本次为首版审计，无历史版本基线可对比。
checked_items.en: The author and repository are zseven-w; this is the first audit of this version, so there is no historical version baseline for comparison.

evidence.zh: 补丁文件仅新增一行插件装载声明，未覆盖沙箱、审批、权限等安全行，也未出现禁用或降权写法（cordis.patch.yml）。
evidence.en: The patch file only adds one line declaring the plugin load; it does not overwrite security lines such as sandbox, approval, or permissions, and no disabling or privilege-lowering patterns appear (cordis.patch.yml).

evidence.zh: 未发现对审批链、工具执行前等安全事件的高优先级监听，无截断审批链的代码。
evidence.en: No high-priority listeners for security events such as approval chains or pre-tool-execution were found, and no code that truncates the approval chain was found.

evidence.zh: 首版审计，无上一版本基线可比较，升级自动激活场景不适用。
evidence.en: First audit of this version; no previous version baseline for comparison; the upgrade auto-activation scenario is not applicable.

evidence.zh: 补丁未改写依赖注入与拦截配置，无给安全插件追加不存在服务致其永久等待的写法。
evidence.en: The patch does not rewrite dependency injection or interception configuration, and no pattern that adds non-existent services to security plugins causing them to wait forever was found.

checked_items.zh: 检查插件是否自行监听端口：未发现；插件只在宿主 Web 服务上注册路由，且对编辑器相关路由强制校验本机回环对端、同源与签名能力令牌，对渲染/查看器资源用签名令牌与路径校验控制访问。
checked_items.en: Checked whether the plugin listens on a port itself: none found; the plugin only registers routes on the host Web service, and for editor-related routes it enforces loopback peer, same-origin, and signing capability token checks, while render/viewer resources are access-controlled with signing tokens and path validation.

checked_items.zh: 宿主的本机无认证 RPC 属生态固有属性（官方文档明示 Host 围栏只是可达性策略而非认证层），非本插件引入；本插件的路由在其之上额外加了回环对端与签名能力校验。
checked_items.en: The host's local unauthenticated RPC is an inherent property of the ecosystem (official docs state that the Host fence is only a reachability policy, not an authentication layer), and was not introduced by this plugin; on top of that, the plugin's routes add loopback peer and signing capability validation.

checked_items.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（无动态观测产物），运行时行为结论基于静态分析。
checked_items.en: No dynamic sandbox verification was performed (no dynamic observation artifacts); runtime behavior conclusions are based on static analysis.

evidence.zh: 插件未自行启动监听端口，而是在宿主 Web 服务上注册受限路由（要求本机回环对端、同源与签名能力）；宿主无认证 RPC 属生态固有风险，本插件未扩大该面。
evidence.en: The plugin does not start a listening port itself; instead it registers restricted routes on the host Web service (requiring loopback peer, same-origin, and signing capability). The host's unauthenticated RPC is an inherent ecosystem risk; this plugin does not expand that surface.

summary.zh: 核对插件元数据与身份：dsh 声明（bundle 补丁 + 浏览器客户端注入）合法，依赖均为官方 @deepseek-ai 包，作者 zseven-w，未发现名称仿冒。
summary.en: Verified plugin metadata and identity: the dsh declarations (bundle patch + browser client injection) are valid; dependencies are all official @deepseek-ai packages; the author is zseven-w; no name spoofing was found.

summary.zh: 静态扫描全部源码与配置：未发现可执行 YAML 标量、eval/动态构造、安装钩子、凭据读取或外联域名；机械命中的 11 项（进程启动、浏览器交互、CI 基础设施）逐条裁决均属良性。
summary.en: Static scan of all source code and configuration: no executable YAML scalars, no eval/dynamic construction, no install hooks, no credential reads, and no outbound domains were found; the 11 mechanically-flagged items (process launches, browser interactions, CI infrastructure) were adjudicated one by one as benign.

summary.zh: 行为面分析：无安装钩子、无混淆载荷、无凭据文件读取、无对外部域名的外联；进程启动均为声明功能的本地渲染器/编辑器守护进程。
summary.en: Behavioral surface analysis: no install hooks, no obfuscated payloads, no credential file reads, no outbound connections to external domains; process launches are all local renderer/editor daemons for declared functionality.

summary.zh: AI 元数据审查：5 个工具的描述与参数、文档与客户端文案均未发现提示词注入、诱导安装或隐藏意图。
summary.en: AI metadata review: the descriptions and parameters of the 5 tools, documentation, and client texts show no prompt injection, installation inducement, or hidden intent.

summary.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（无动态观测产物）。
summary.en: No dynamic sandbox verification was performed (no dynamic observation artifacts).

limits.zh: 适用性确认：package.json 含 dsh.bundle/dsh.client 声明并依赖 @deepseek-ai 宿主包，属 dsh 生态插件。插件清单未显式声明能力，declared_capabilities 按代码实测推断（network=false、shell=false、fs=write、modelFacing=true）。DG-L4 动态沙箱未启用，未做动态验证。.github/workflows 与 .gitmodules 因工具限制无法全文读取，依据预扫摘录与文件清单核对；vendor/ 子模块内容不在快照内，仅按 .gitmodules 声明评估。渲染/编辑器工具直接以系统文件接口读取 .op 文件并启动本机渲染器/编辑器二进制（二进制发现路径含环境变量与 PATH），属工具声明的核心功能。
limits.en: Applicability confirmation: package.json contains dsh.bundle/dsh.client declarations and depends on @deepseek-ai host packages, qualifying it as a dsh ecosystem plugin. The plugin manifest does not explicitly declare capabilities; declared_capabilities are inferred from code testing (network=false, shell=false, fs=write, modelFacing=true). DG-L4 dynamic sandbox is not enabled, so no dynamic verification was performed. .github/workflows and .gitmodules could not be fully read due to tool limitations; they were checked against pre-scan excerpts and the file manifest. The vendor/ submodule content is not included in the snapshot and was evaluated only based on the .gitmodules declaration. The render/editor tools directly read .op files through the system file interface and launch local renderer/editor binaries (binary discovery path includes environment variables and PATH), which is the tools' declared core functionality.
